raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, a new 'v2' collector began sending transactions, with no change note announcing it. Its txn_ts values sit exactly 6 hours ahead of the legacy collector: v2 days start at about 12:00 while legacy days start at about 06:00, which looks like UTC versus local UTC-6. As a result, evening v2 transactions roll into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which inflates the off-hours counts and creates the spurious 2026-01-19 rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
